data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=QPiJqllYwUUQ7kNvgGA_fjW&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBRxi8HCKCPEvtBX1zgsH05nSIAKNo6ahYQKHei9N3b3A&oe=672CA51C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=z2I0boFmPagQ7kNvgF2YrPt&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAqWfYTYiHDqWXzELs7RN9MFToHWWkf2-yTgAXPERn5iw&oe=672CAEA4)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=NU9r5Rz4Wx4Q7kNvgECP2am&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDA5SC9w-a6wzODu6UgrJd9Up6Bg9B9aR3dBFoUdtmuOA&oe=672C9607)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=F-aq3mwrn7gQ7kNvgEqr5bs&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAQ7yAFltTrSznGrEcicaAuFV0qVkqKhEf7brzuJNZ7PQ&oe=672C88E6)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=DfHI_3va92kQ7kNvgEXfyvk&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBq-DMOKCb3ZpW0qHedOclenlsca-0OGDNl-_dYhXOTrA&oe=672CB558)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=G2PIBkgrHhgQ7kNvgFaI8vL&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCBGToV4CgEsr_4ZFU8CyHgx2Ke5tcBWIZa2IkVw6tGFQ&oe=672CB1D9)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=miTym6xW2jwQ7kNvgGn0GQx&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAB5Z1nlFXr6h7EXn69b_jW4GZv5ISqsTGfwK1MOzYSFg&oe=672C97F0)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=BSEerBM0f1IQ7kNvgEiUXVM&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYACQG2MG1b8PKbQENSSXFLwWDeI4z51lPuIncp6NwWAVg&oe=672CBAAA)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=qdnFIPmOT2cQ7kNvgH772j-&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC0W_7C0AYPi9ySzQzfwDgpkOjcswXclU_acwxFmlmjCw&oe=672C9617)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=LsU05WT7uDwQ7kNvgHIANUK&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sjc3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBEMJ0hcUSgOvUInBo1GNed-bq7kGTHZbrnJSDhynClyQ&oe=672CB18C)
